run_inverse_dynamics_simulation: run the pybullet inverse dynamics simulation for a two joint robot with torque control
calculate_inverse_dynamics_torque: calculate the required joint torques using bullet.calculateInverseDynamics given position velocity and acceleration
load_urdf_robot: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulator using bullet.loadURDF with a fixed base
set_joint_torque_control: set joint motor torque control using bullet.setJointMotorControlArray with TORQUE_CONTROL mode
read_joint_states: read joint position and velocity states using bullet.getJointStates for specified revolute joints
